d: A figure with a sturdy, athletic build, completely concealed by a full suit of polished silver plate armor including a closed helmet with a narrow-slitted visor. The outfit consists of a silver breastplate, tiered pauldrons, gauntlets, and greaves worn over a dark blue tunic and trousers. The figure holds a long spear with a brown wooden shaft and a silver metallic tip accented with gold. No hair, eyes, or facial features are visible.
